- Bridge letter: we can produce a one-page bridge confirming the SOC 2 Type II report period (2023-05-01 to 2024-04-30) and stating that subsequent configuration changes made between 2024-04-30 and 2024-05-15 were not part of the tested period; we will include language about compensating controls where relevant. - MFA enrollment/change events: we can provide a sample export with the fields you requested. Note that our identity provider (IdP) stores full device metadata; we will provide the event-level change with a link to the device type classification rather than device identifiers.

- Access review confirmation: our privileged access review cadence is quarterly; the last review that touched privileged accounts occurred on 2024-03-28 and we will include the review artifact reference (internal ticket id).

- Delivery and limitations: we can deliver the bridge letter draft + the two CSV extracts by 2027-06-09 EOD PT. If ACME requires unhashed emails or device identifiers, we'll need a DSS-approved request and an amended DPA/NDA.

I'll attach the draft bridge letter and a sample CSV schema.
